description: Trend statistics for run8's 20 GRPO iterations, as plotted in assets/run8_divergence.png. Recorded so the autocorrelation check -- including the correction we computed and declined to adopt -- is auditable rather than only asserted.

autocorrelation.verdict: No positive serial correlation worth correcting.

newey_west_computed_but_not_adopted.why_not_adopted: HAC standard errors are unreliable at n=20 and both t values moved UP, which would have turned the non-significant success trend significant. Adopting a correction because it favours the result is the failure mode this project is about. OLS is reported.

drift_shape.verdict: Decelerating but not flattening. Calling it a plateau overstated it.

multiplicity: Three trends inspected, none preregistered; two of the three would not survive a correction.
